[/page/1/Text/8] In this baseline assessment 7449 subjects were interviewed, of whom 21.7% had significant depressive symptoms. To perform a stratified analysis of factors associated with depressive symptom trajectories between those subjects with significant depressive symptoms, and those without these symptoms, an identical number of subjects without significant depressive symptoms at baseline was randomly selected, and was followed up, along with the other group.
